quests.name: Messenger to Stormwind
quests.text: Magistrate Solomon has given you a report which must be delivered to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind. The judge wants you to return to him as soon as the delivery has been made.

quests.name: Messenger to Stormwind
quests.text: Take General Marcus Jonathan's letter of response to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.

quests.name: Messenger to Westfall
quests.text: Magistrate Solomon wants you to take his written plea to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.

quests.name: Messenger to Westfall
quests.text: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Gryan Stoutmantle's response.

quests.name: Dry Times
quests.text: Barkeep Daniels of Lakeshire needs a keg of Thunderbrew Lager, a cask of Merlot, a bottle of Moonshine and a skin of Sweet Rum.

quests.name: A Free Lunch
quests.text: Bring Parker's lunch to Guard Parker. He patrols the road leading to Darkshire.

quests.name: Visit the Herbalist
quests.text: Speak with the Redridge Herbalist, Martie Jainrose.

quests.name: Delivering Daffodils
quests.text: Give Darcy the Daffodil Bouquet.

quests.name: Hilary's Necklace
quests.text: Find Hilary's Necklace, and return it to Hilary in Lakeshire.

quests.name: Encroaching Gnolls
quests.text: Report to Deputy Feldon.

quests.name: The Lost Tools
quests.text: Foreman Oslow of Lakeshire wants you to retrieve his toolbox from the bottom of Lake Everstill.

quests.name: Assessing the Threat
quests.text: Kill 10 Redridge Mongrels and 6 Redridge Poachers, then report back to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire.

quests.name: Show of Force
quests.text: Collect 5 Spiked Collars from Redridge Thrashers for Deputy Feldon near Lakeshire.

quests.name: Return to Verner
quests.text: Return to Verner Osgood in Redridge. Give him the Crate of Horseshoes.

quests.name: The Price of Shoes
quests.text: Take Verner's Note to Smith Argus in Goldshire.

quests.name: Underbelly Scales
quests.text: Gather 6 Underbelly Whelp Scales from Black Dragon Whelps, and bring them to Verner Osgood in Redridge.

quests.name: Redridge Goulash
quests.text: Chef Breanna of Lakeshire wants five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.

quests.name: Messenger to Darkshire
quests.text: Magistrate Solomon wants you to take a letter to Lord Ebonlocke in Darkshire.

quests.name: Messenger to Darkshire
quests.text: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Lord Ebonlocke's letter of response.

quests.name: The Everstill Bridge
quests.text: Bring 5 Iron Pikes and 5 Iron Rivets to Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire.

quests.name: A Baying of Gnolls
quests.text: Kill 10 Redridge Brutes and 8 Redridge Mystics, then return to Verner Osgood.

quests.name: Alther's Mill
quests.text: Open Lucius's Lockbox, recover the Token of Thievery and return it to Lucius in Lakeshire.

quests.name: Murloc Poachers
quests.text: Bring 8 Murloc Fins to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.

quests.name: Alther's Mill
quests.text: Slay 12 Greater Tarantulas and destroy 6 Tarantula Eggs in Alther's Mill for Foreman Oslow in Redridge.

quests.name: Selling Fish
quests.text: Bring 10 Spotted Sunfish to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.

quests.name: Blackrock Menace
quests.text: Bring 10 Battleworn Axes to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.

quests.name: Blackrock Blockade
quests.text: Bring 8 Stolen Weapons and 10 Blackrock Supplies to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.

quests.name: A Watchful Eye
quests.text: Take the Glyph of Azora to the Lion Statue near the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge.

quests.name: Horns of Nez'ra
quests.text: Return the Horns of Nez'ra to Arantir's Shadow in Lakeshire.

quests.name: Looking Further
quests.text: Climb the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep.  Find a suitable container to place the Glyph of Azora.

quests.name: The Rethban Gauntlet
quests.text: Enter the Rethban Caverns, reach the first fork, and return to Yorus Barleybrew within the time allowed.  You must not die and release your spirit.

quests.name: The Shieldsmith
quests.text: Bring the Cask of Scalder to Furen Longbeard.

quests.name: Theocritus' Retrieval
quests.text: Bring the Faded Shadowhide Pendant to Theocritus the Mage.

quests.name: Solomon's Law
quests.text: Bring 10 Shadowhide Pendants to Bailiff Conacher in the Lakeshire Town Hall.

quests.name: Shadow Magic
quests.text: Bring 3 Midnight Orbs to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.

quests.name: An Unwelcome Guest
quests.text: Martie Jainrose of Lakeshire wants you to kill Bellygrub. Bring her his tusk as proof.

quests.name: Howling in the Hills
quests.text: Bring Yowler's Paw to Verner Osgood in Lakeshire.

quests.name: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im
quests.text: Deliver the Broken Staff of Incinerator Gar'im to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.

quests.name: Tharil'zun
quests.text: Bring Tharil'zun's Head to Marshal Marris in Redridge.

quests.name: Missing In Action
quests.text: Protect Corporal Keeshan on the journey back to Redridge.

objectives.text: Escort Corporal Keeshan back to Redridge

quests.name: Blackrock Bounty
quests.text: Kill 15 Blackrock Champions and Guard Howe in Lakeshire will reward you.

quests.name: WANTED: Gath'Ilzogg
quests.text: Kill Gath'Ilzogg and bring his head to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire for the reward.

quests.name: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore
quests.text: Kill Lieutenant Fangore and return to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire with his paw.

quests.name: Morganth
quests.text: Defeat Morganth.  Bring his Pendant of Shadow to Theocritus at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest.

quests.name: Sign Me Up!
quests.text: Bring the completed form to Elaine Compton in Redridge Mountains.

quests.name: Shipping Label
quests.text: Deliver the Shipping Label to someone at the Azeroth Commerce Authority trade hub in Redridge Mountains.

quests.name: Shipping Label
quests.text: Deliver the Shipping Label to someone at the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade hub near the Crossroads in the Barrens.
